SPECIFICATION FOR 
COSMETIC HAND, ARTIFICIAL LIMB 



1. Scope — Specifies dimensional and functional requirements of cosmetic hand used for cosmetic 
purposes in upper limb prosthetic fitments. 

2. Shape, Size and Dimensions 

2.1 Shape of the cosmetic hand is shown in Fig. 1 for guidance. The major dimensions shall be as 
indicated in table under Fig. 1. 




ADAPTER 



■WIRE CAGE

All dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 HAND. COSMETIC 

2.2 Cosmetic hand shall normally be made In 3 sizes namely small, medium and large meant to be 
used on child, ladies and adults. 

2.3 The overall width of the cosmetic hand shall be decided by the distance between the head of the 
metacarpals of index finger and little finger. It shall be denoted by 'W. 

2.4 The overall height of the cosmetic hand from the level of wrist region to thumb vertex shall be 
decided by keeping the thumb parpendicular to the plane of wrist. This shall be denoted by W.

3. Material 

3.1 Light weight materials such as plastics shall be used as filling material to meet the desrred 
functisnalibility. Wire cages may be from materials such as aluminium alloy, copper galvanized mild 
steel wire etc. The materials shall conform to the requirements of the relevant Indian Standards 
wherever applicable. 

4. Functional Requirements 

4.1 The cosmetic hand shall have anatomically proportionate fingers and thumb. The shape may be 
in the functional position as shown in Fig. 1. 

4.2 The hand construction shall be rigid enough to allow stretching of outer glove over it for better 
cosmetic appearance. 

4.3 The fingers and thumb shall be capable of being passively operated independently to achieve 
different posture positions. 

4.4 Provision of an adapter with M 10 or M 12 threading for securing the wrist unit shall be made in 
accordance with IS : 5594-1 983 'Wrist unit rotary for hand prosthesis {ff'rst revision )\ The cosmetic 
hand shall match with the wrist unit at the wrist region. 

4.5 The cosmetic hand shall be given an asthetic smooth finish. 

5. Marking — The cosmetic hand shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognised 
trade-mark and its size. 

5.1 ISl Certification Marking — Details available with Indian Standards institution. 

6. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 

7. Sampling — Sampling scheme and acceptance criteria shall be as agreed to between the 
manufacturer and the purchaser. However a recommended sampling plan is given in Appendix A. 



APPENDIX A 

( Ciause 7 ) 
SAMPLING PLAN AND CRITERIA FOR CONFORMITY 

A-l. Lot — In any consignment all the cosmetic hand of the same size and manufactured from the 
same material shall be grouped together to constitute the lot. 

A-2. The number of the cosmetic hand to be selected at random from each lot shall be in accordance 
with col 1 and 2 of Table 1 . 

TABLE 1 SCALE OF SAMPLING AND CRSTERrA FOR CONFORMITY 

Lot Size Sample Size 

3 

126 to 50 S 

51 „ 100 8 

101 ,, 150 13 

151 and above 20 

A-2.1 In order to ensure the randomness of selection, procedures given in IS : 4905-1968 'Methods 
for random sampling' may be followed. 

A-3. Number of Tests and Criteria for Conformity — Each cosmetic hand selected in accordance 
with 7.2 and Table 1, shall be inspected for shape, size and dimensions and functional requirements. 
A cosmetic hand shall be considered as defective if it fails to satisfy any one or more, of the require- 
ments. A lot shall be considered as conforming to the requirements of the standard if none of the 
cosmetic hand in the sample is found defective. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In the preparation of this standard considerable assistance has been given by Artificial Limbs 
Manufacturing Corporation, Kanpur. In this standard main emphasis is on the functional requirements.
